authority_basis: 2026-08-16 owner addendum authorizes FIT+CAL corpus generation and baselines; this amendment corrects an internally invalid baseline description before generation.

replacement_semantics.persistence: For each of the 51 targets, persist the latest causal public observation from its exact frozen source mapping: environmental targets use the ordered primary sensor head, falling back only to the named secondary head when primary is unavailable; airflow and resource targets use their exact operational-feedback instrument. If neither named environmental head is available, abstain/reject that example. Do not average heads or synthesize target estimates.
replacement_semantics.training_feature_history: The compact history for both learned baselines uses the same ordered source-grounded mapping; availability remains evidence only and is never averaged into a target.

split_integrity.roster_id_note: Exact roster IDs lowercase the load path segment; split semantics use the signed PilotCluster.load_regime field and never reconstruct semantics by parsing IDs.

supersedes_semantics.invalidated_text: persistence is the availability-averaged target estimate
